verdict.rationale: Undermind documents an official hosted MCP server at https://mcp.undermind.ai/mcp. It gives setup instructions for Claude Code (`claude mcp add --transport http`), Cursor and VS Code, plus a published ChatGPT app, and states compatibility with any MCP client using CIMD-based client identification. The docs also list the exposed tools: deep literature review, parallel full-text PDF reading, Markdown notes, folders and starring. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on community corroboration that connecting an agent through the MCP server works as documented.
